BPW-2026-0505
BOE + BCA
CD 4
CONTRACT AWARD – NORTH OUTFALL SEWER REHABILITATION UNIT 33 MAGNOLIA BOULEVARD AND WOODMAN AVENUE (RE-BID)
Recommending the Board:
DECLARE Spiniello Infrastructure West, Inc., the first low bidder, to be the lowest responsive, responsible bidder, and AWARD Spiniello a contract for the North Outfall Sewer Rehabilitation Unit 33 - Magnolia Boulevard and Woodman Avenue (Re-Bid) for $31,314,495; and
AUTHORIZE the President or two members Of the Board to execute the contract after approval as to form has been obtained from the City Attorney.
(W.O.: SZC14011)
summary: Contract award to Spiniello Infrastructure West, Inc. for North Outfall Sewer Rehabilitation Unit 33 at Magnolia Boulevard and Woodman Avenue in Council District 4 for $31,314,495.
